components.description: Resets a completed experiment without competing with the primary action.

components.name: Node Specimen
components.description: An equal peer cell that gains visual weight only after selection or protocol authority.

components.name: Ruled Navigation
components.description: Cell-based navigation with one blue active state.

narrative.overview: The explainers borrow the rigor of an interactive variable-type specimen: paper, black ink, one signal blue, hairline rules, and dramatic shifts in typographic weight. Protocol state is the specimen. A role change should alter the visual weight of a node as clearly as an axis change alters a glyph.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white fields with black one-pixel rules.
Signal blue reserved for active choices, confirmed state, focus, and causality.
Large variable display type paired with compact data labels.
Square, ruled controls with no ornamental containers.
Text equivalents for every color or motion change.

rules.name: The Signal Means State Rule
rules.body: Blue is never decoration; it marks an action, selection, focus, protocol outcome, or causal direction.

rules.name: The State Has Weight Rule
rules.body: Use weight and width changes for protocol authority; do not substitute badges, glows, or decorative icons.

dos: Do ask for a prediction before revealing state.
Do connect every blue mark to a semantic state or action.
Do keep peer nodes equal until the protocol produces a distinction.
Do expose causal events as ordered text.
donts: Don't wrap lessons in generic rounded cards.
Don't use neon, gradients, glows, or code-themed decoration.
Don't use color or motion as the only state signal.
Don't turn compact data labels into the primary reading voice.
